channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Moses Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Moses Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Moses Brown
item.description:
J.B. Bickerstaff on Brown:

“He’s long. He’s rangy. He has good athleticism. He knows how to patrol the paint at both ends of the floor. Really good rim roller and lob threat, so he’s a similar build to what we have and what we value.”

JB Bickerstaff on Moses Brown, Mar 10, 2022. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: Al Horford on Moses Brown
item.description:
Al Horford on Moses Brown:

“He's a great kid. Guys are going to love him in the locker room. ... He's all about the team and trying to play the right way.”

Al Horford on Moses Brown, Jun 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Moses Brown
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Mark Daigneault on Moses Brown's contract:

“We're happy for him and we're happy for us. This process started when he came back from the Bubble. It was apparent he was a worker. He's a good kid. He showed improvement. It's only the beginning of his time here.”

Mark Daigneault on Moses Brown, Mar 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
